accent_use: one muted accent, primary CTA only
type_pairing: humanist serif display + neutral sans text
signature_move: generous whitespace around a single focal point per section
avoid: badges, gradients, more than one filled button per view

accent_use: near-monochrome; accent as a thin rule or one word
signature_move: oversized display type with tight leading and lots of air
avoid: stock icon grids, rounded-everything, saturated color

accent_use: one cool accent; semantic colors used strictly
signature_move: consistent components and visible states everywhere
avoid: novel controls, hidden states, decorative color

accent_use: one high-contrast accent reserved for the single urgent action
signature_move: one high-contrast focal action, progress or countdown visible
avoid: urgency colors on non-urgent content, multiple competing CTAs

type_pairing: rounded or geometric sans display + friendly sans text
signature_move: one surprising detail (illustration, motion) per screen, not ten
avoid: emoji as icons, every element animated

type_pairing: serif text or strong grotesk, two weights
signature_move: strict grid with a shared left edge and a clear reading order
avoid: centered body text, soft pastel decoration

signature_move: narrow measure, personal copy, small deliberate entry
avoid: dashboard chrome, dense UI, all caps

signature_move: example first, then the control; visible labels everywhere

accent_use: one accent + one moment of color
signature_move: one well-timed moment (completion, empty state) that rewards
avoid: delight on every click, slow motion everywhere

accent_use: accent for selection and status only
type_pairing: one sans family with tabular figures
signature_move: tables and panels with strict alignment and tabular numbers
avoid: marketing spacing, cards for every row, decorative color
